scenes.text: In most electric cars, you can drive all day without ever touching the brake pedal.
Lift off the accelerator, and the motor flips into a generator.
Its magnetic drag slows the car, at about a fifth of full braking force, while the energy flows back into the battery.
Near walking pace, the friction brakes quietly finish the stop, and hold you in place.
And yes, your brake lights still come on, so the driver behind you knows.
Would you drive with just one pedal? Follow EV Drive.
